description:
2:00 Was Moses truly slow of speech, or just doubting himself? Did he already know God would use him to deliver Israel? And who was the Angel that spoke from the burning bush and on Mount Sinai—was it Jesus or Michael?

11:25 What does the Bible say about angels and their mission? Do we really have guardian angels? Can angels read our thoughts—or only God can? How organized is Satan’s army, and do demons follow a hierarchy or act independently?

In this thought-provoking episode of Me Gustaría Saber, Pastors Stephen Bohr and Daniel Miranda dive deep into some of the most fascinating—and often misunderstood—topics in Scripture:

chapters.title: Was Moses truly slow of speech, or just doubting himself? Did he already know God would use him to deliver Israel? And who was the Angel that spoke from the burning bush and on Mount Sinai—was it Jesus or Michael?

What does the Bible say about angels and their mission? Do we really have guardian angels? Can angels read our thoughts—or only God can? How organized is Satan’s army, and do demons follow a hierarchy or act independently?
